items.title_zh: AMD FSR SDK 2.4 发布，为 Vulkan 图形 API 带来 "Redstone" 特性
items.title_en: AMD releases FSR SDK 2.4, bringing 'Redstone' features to Vulkan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 29 日消息，AMD 当地时间 28 日发布了 2.4 版本的 FSR 软件开发套件。这是首个支持 Vulkan 的 FSR "Redstone" 版本， 为该图形 API 带来了与 DirectX 12 相同的超分辨率与帧生成功能 。 AMD 提到，当前使用 AMD FSR 3.1 进行图像放大或帧生成的 Vulkan 游戏不会通过驱动程序自动升级到基于机器学习的 FSR 超分辨率或帧生成，因为这些升级仅适用于 DirectX 12 游戏。 FSR SDK 2.4 也正式在 AMD Radeon RX 6000 系列独立显卡、多款锐龙 APU 上支持 FSR 超分辨率 4.1.2。需要注意的是，Radeon RX 6000 和锐龙 AI Max 处理器使用的是 Radeon 7000 系列同款 INT8 模型，而 其余 APU 则仅支持大小不到一半的精简优化模型 。
items.summary_en: AMD released FSR SDK 2.4, the first Vulkan-capable FSR “Redstone” version, bringing the same super-resolution and frame-generation features available on DirectX 12. AMD said existing Vulkan games using FSR 3.1 will not automatically upgrade to ML-based FSR, as those upgrades are DX12-only. The SDK adds FSR 4.1.2 support on Radeon RX 6000 GPUs and several Ryzen APUs, with some APUs limited to a smaller optimized model.
items.why_zh: FSR向Vulkan扩展有助于让更多跨平台游戏获得ML超分和帧生成，缩小与竞品在API覆盖上的差距。
items.why_en: Extending FSR to Vulkan helps more cross-platform games access ML upscaling and frame generation, narrowing the API-coverage gap with rivals.

items.title_zh: 论文《数绷带》：如何衡量AI真正节省的时间
items.title_en: Counting the Bandages: On measuring the time that AI saves
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文讨论“AI辅助究竟是否节省时间”这一度量问题。作者对比两种视角：一种是“秒表观”，即只记录时钟上节省的时间；另一种是“账本观”，即把节省的时间视为反事实，并需与工作放过的错误一起衡量。论文主张采用后者，提出“节省时间”和“超额逃逸缺陷”两个不依赖具体模型的量，以及由二者构成的决策指标“盈亏平衡缺陷成本”，并给出一个检查行为的基线模型。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.35942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: I consider what it means for AI assistance to save time. I contrast a stopwatch view, on which time saved is whatever the clock records, with a ledger view, on which it is a counterfactual that has to be read next to the errors the work lets through, and I argue for the latter. The argument has four parts. I define a model-free pair of quantities, time saved and excess escaped defects, and one decision number built from them: the break-even defect cost. I give a baseline model of checking in which, until the model is good enough not to check, a c…
items.why_zh: 它为评估AI生产力提供了把返工和错误成本纳入考量的框架，避免夸大AI的省时效果。
items.why_en: It offers a framework that factors rework and error costs into AI productivity, helping avoid overstated time savings.

items.title_zh: CohortFlow：可局部语义修正的临床队列筛选智能体
items.title_en: CohortFlow: A Steerable Clinical Cohort Curation Agent with Localized Semantic Correction
items.summary_zh: 论文提出 CohortFlow，一种用于临床队列筛选的可引导语言模型智能体，旨在让系统在入组标准变化时无需反复处理未变动的需求。该方法把自然语言修正转化为对结构化队列规格的局部更新，并与持久化执行图协调；通过显式记录语义依赖，系统可只让受影响的计算失效，同时保留此前有效结果。摘要称，研究在100个源自临床试验入组标准的场景上进行了评估，但未给出具体性能数字。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language model agents for clinical cohort curation should accommodate evolving eligibility criteria without repeatedly processing unchanged requirements. We introduce CohortFlow, a steerable agent that represents natural language corrections as localized updates to a structured cohort specification and reconciles them with a persistent execution graph. Explicitly recorded semantic dependencies enable affected computations to be selectively invalidated while preserving valid prior results. On 100 scenarios derived from clinical-trial eligibility c…
items.why_zh: 让临床队列筛选更高效地响应标准变更，有望减少重复计算并提升AI辅助研究的可用性。
items.why_en: More efficient responses to changing criteria could reduce redundant computation and improve AI-assisted clinical research workflows.

items.title_zh: 当AI更擅长科学时，人类为何以及如何做科学：一个基于人类理解与方向的框架
items.title_en: Why and How to Do Science When AI Is Better at It: A Framework Grounded in Human Understanding and Direction
items.summary_zh: 随着AI开始在核心科研任务上达到或超越人类研究者水平，论文提出两个紧迫问题：人类为何还要继续从事科学，以及在科研中应如何使用AI。作者认为，第二个问题只能通过回答第一个问题来解决。论文主张，科学不可或缺的目标之一是“以人类目的与价值为导向，追求持久、集体的人类对世界的理解”。基于这一原则，作者推导出一套两部分测试，用于判断某项研究任务何时可以交给AI。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As AI begins to match or exceed human researchers at core scientific tasks, two questions become pressing: \emph{why} should humans keep doing science, and \emph{how} should they use AI when they do? This paper argues that the second can be answered only by answering the first. It holds that one indispensable aim of science is \emph{durable, collective human understanding of the world, pursued in service of human ends and values}. From this principle it derives a two-part test for when a research task can be delegated to AI. The first part, \emph…
items.why_zh: 为AI深度参与科研时的分工、伦理与人类目标提供原则性框架。
items.why_en: It offers a principled framework for division of labor, ethics, and human purpose as AI takes on more scientific work.

items.title_zh: 利用追踪数据的分位数回归学习人类运动可行性
items.title_en: Learning Human Sports Motion Feasibility via Quantile Regression on Tracking Data
items.summary_zh: 论文研究体育中的到达时间（TTA），即球员从当前运动状态出发，到达场上任意位置所需的最短合理时间，并将其估计为观测到的移动时间的下包络。作者不采用位置密度估计或闭式物理模型来建模空间控制，而是把TTA构造为条件分位数回归问题，通过估计移动时间的低分位数，让模型学习球员的下包络到达时间。模型使用光学追踪数据进行训练。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36183v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study time-to-arrival (TTA) in sports: the shortest plausible time a player needs to reach an arbitrary location on the pitch given their current kinematic state, estimated as the lower envelope of observed locomotion times. Rather than modeling space ownership through position density estimation or closed-form physics-based models, we cast TTA as a conditional quantile regression problem, estimating the lower quantile of locomotion time so the model learns a player's lower-envelope arrival time. We train the model on optical tracking data fro…
items.why_zh: 为评估球员空间控制与运动可行性提供了一种数据驱动的建模方法。
items.why_en: It provides a data-driven way to model players' spatial control and motion feasibility.

items.title_zh: MARQ：融合系统工程知识的模块化、与LLM无关的需求质量评估器
items.title_en: MARQ: A Modular, LLM-Agnostic Requirement Quality Assessor Infused with Systems Engineering Knowledge
items.summary_zh: 需求工程是系统工程的基础，需求缺陷会向下游传播并影响开发结果。大型语言模型在需求质量评估上具有潜力，但已有工作显示，现成模型会漏掉相当一部分专家识别的缺陷，在不同质量标准上表现不均，且多次执行结果存在波动。论文研究能否通过注入专家提炼的系统工程知识，提升基于LLM的需求质量评估效果。为此提出MARQ，一个模块化、不依赖特定LLM的需求质量评估器。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Requirements engineering (RE) is foundational to systems engineering (SE), as requirement defects can propagate downstream and adversely affect development outcomes. Although large language models (LLMs) are promising for requirement quality assessment, prior work shows that off-the-shelf models miss a large share of expert-identified defects, perform unevenly across quality criteria, and vary across executions. This study investigates whether infusing expert-derived SE knowledge can improve LLM-based requirement quality evaluation beyond off-the…
items.why_zh: 有望提升LLM在需求缺陷检测中的覆盖度、一致性与可靠性。
items.why_en: It could improve the coverage, consistency, and reliability of LLM-based requirement defect detection.

items.title_zh: BehaveRec：长期行为历史何时有助于序列推荐？
items.title_en: BehaveRec: When Does Long-Term Behavioral History Help Sequential Recommendation? A Study with Session, History, and Community Signals
items.summary_zh: 序列推荐模型通常根据近期会话交互预测用户下一步行为，当短期信号较弱或含糊时，个性化效果受限。论文不预设引入长期历史和社区信号一定有益，而是研究它们在什么情况下真正有帮助。作者提出三信号框架BehaveRec，结合因果会话Transformer、覆盖90天窗口的双向用户历史编码器，以及基于行为嵌入相似度构建的用户-用户图上的GraphSAGE模块。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential recommendation models typically predict a user's next action from recent session interactions, which limits personalization when short-term signals are weak or ambiguous. Rather than assuming that incorporating longer-term history and community signals is universally beneficial, we study when it actually helps. We propose BehaveRec, a three-signal framework combining a causal session transformer, a bidirectional User History Encoder over a 90-day window, and a GraphSAGE module over a user-user graph built from behavioral embedding simi…
items.why_zh: 帮助理解长期行为历史与社区信号在序列推荐中的适用条件，而非盲目叠加信号。
items.why_en: It clarifies when long-term history and community signals actually help sequential recommendation instead of assuming they always do.

items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络更难被窃取：模型窃取攻击基准研究
items.title_en: Spiking Neural Networks Are Harder to Steal: A Benchmark Study of Model Stealing Attacks
items.summary_zh: 部署在查询接口后的机器学习模型暴露的不只是预测结果，攻击者还可利用这些预测重建模型本身。模型窃取攻击通过纯黑箱查询训练替代模型，复制目标模型的决策行为，无需访问其参数或训练数据。此类攻击在传统人工神经网络（ANN）中已有较充分刻画，但脉冲神经网络（SNN）的信息处理方式根本不同。论文据此对SNN开展模型窃取攻击的基准研究，考察其抗窃取特性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36298v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning models deployed behind query interfaces expose more than their predictions, because an adversary can use those predictions to rebuild the model itself. Model stealing attacks (MSAs) exploit this exposure by training a surrogate model that replicates the decision behavior of a target through black-box queries alone, without access to its parameters or training data. These attacks are well characterized for conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs), yet spiking neural networks (SNNs) process information in a fundamentally diff…
items.why_zh: 揭示SNN在信息处理机制差异下可能具有不同的模型窃取风险与防护特性。
items.why_en: It reveals how the distinct information processing of SNNs may change model-stealing risk and protection.

items.title_zh: 当检索不够：智能体记忆中的过时事实
items.title_en: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
items.summary_zh: 记忆智能体基准常把检索与答案生成合并为一个分数，难以判断失败究竟是因为没有检索到更新，还是因为已检索到更新却未加以利用。论文在MemoryAgentBench的单跳FactConsolidation任务上区分这两种情况。使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和6K历史长度的BM25检索时，检索证据预算从64个token增至512个token，准确率反而从45%降至32%，尽管金标准辅助的事后审计发现每个检索集都包含最新陈述。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Memory-agent benchmarks often collapse retrieval and answer generation into one score, making it hard to tell whether a failure comes from missing an update or from not using an update that was already retrieved. We examine this distinction on the single-hop FactConsolidation task of MemoryAgentBench. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on 6K-history BM25 accuracy drops from 45% to 32% when the retrieved evidence budget grows from 64 to 512 tokens, even though a gold-assisted post-hoc audit finds the newest statement in every retrieved set. Most of the erro…
items.why_zh: 指出智能体记忆评估需分离检索与更新利用，避免把“检索到”误当作“会用”。
items.why_en: It shows that agent-memory evaluation must separate retrieval from update use rather than treating retrieved as used.

items.title_zh: 本体引导的多智能体推理用于可解释鉴别诊断
items.title_en: Ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning for explainable differential diagnosis
items.summary_zh: 有效的鉴别诊断依赖于结构良好、无歧义的病例描述，因为不完整或含糊的临床信息容易导致诊断错误和推理不一致。大型语言模型在医学问答和临床推理上展现出潜力，但即便在医学基准上取得有竞争力的表现，它们往往依赖从训练数据中学到的模式识别，而非有据可依的临床证据，并可能生成看似合理的内容。论文提出本体引导的多智能体推理方法，以提升鉴别诊断的可解释性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective differential diagnosis depends on well structured and unambiguous patient case descriptions, since incomplete or ambiguous clinical information readily leads to diagnostic errors and inconsistent reasoning. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promising capabilities in medical question answering and clinical reasoning; however, even when achieving competitive performance on medical benchmarks, they often rely on pattern recognition learned from training data rather than grounded clinical evidence, and can generate plausible…
items.why_zh: 针对LLM临床推理缺乏证据 grounding 的问题，探索可解释鉴别诊断路径。
items.why_en: It addresses LLMs' lack of grounded clinical evidence by exploring explainable differential diagnosis through ontology-guided multi-agent reasoning.

items.title_zh: LLM生成的证明在程序重构下有多稳定？可验证代码生成的压缩测试
items.title_en: How Stable Are LLM-Generated Proofs Under Program Refactoring? A Stress Test for Verifiable Code Generation
items.summary_zh: 可验证代码生成的基准通常只针对一个固定实现来检验证明。论文追问：在保持行为不变的程序重构之后，同一个证明是否仍然有效。作者提出RefactorProof，从固定环境中可编译的185个VERINA任务派生出458个经Lean认证的变体，同时逐字节保持规范与待评估证明不变。VERINA为其中46个任务提供参考证明，这些任务均来自其basic划分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36328v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Benchmarks for verifiable code generation usually test a proof against one fixed implementation. We ask whether the same proof remains valid after a program refactoring that preserves behavior. We introduce RefactorProof, which derives 458 Lean-certified variants from the 185 VERINA tasks that compile in our pinned environment while holding the specification and evaluated proof fixed byte-for-byte. VERINA supplies reference proofs for 46 tasks, all from its basic split; the primary model-versus-reference comparisons further match on 21-25 short,…
items.why_zh: 检验LLM生成的代码证明对程序重构的鲁棒性，弥补固定实现评测的盲点。
items.why_en: It tests the robustness of LLM-generated proofs under refactoring, addressing a blind spot in fixed-implementation benchmarks.

items.title_zh: GPU集群细粒度监控：100毫秒粒度揭示优化空间
items.title_en: Plenty of Room in the Middle: Revealing Opportunities on a GPU Cluster via Fine-Grained Monitoring
items.summary_zh: GPU集群已成为学术界和工业界AI与科学研究的关键算力资源，但高昂成本与不断增长的需求常导致长时间排队。以往的集群监控多工作在秒级或分钟级频率，主要服务于作业级调度，缺少优化GPU级利用率所需的细节。该论文对一所大学的研究用GPU集群进行深入个案研究，以100毫秒为间隔分析资源使用情况，并介绍了所开发的轻量级监控方案（摘要此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36329v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: GPU clusters have become essential computing resources for AI and scientific research in academia and industry. However, their high cost and growing demand often result in long queueing delays. While previous monitoring efforts have operated at second- or minute-level frequencies, they primarily informed job-level scheduling for clusters and lacked the detail needed to optimize GPU-level utilization. This paper presents an in-depth study of a university research GPU cluster, analyzing resource usage at 100 ms intervals. We have developed a lightw…
items.why_zh: 更细粒度的监控有望暴露GPU级低效与调度机会，从而提升昂贵集群的利用率。
items.why_en: Finer-grained monitoring can expose GPU-level inefficiencies and scheduling opportunities, improving utilization of costly clusters.

items.title_zh: kw-bench：在真实工作任务中检验前沿智能体“ harness”
items.title_en: kw-bench: Breaking Frontier Harnesses on Real-World Tasks
items.summary_zh: 新一代前沿模型在“harness”（包含循环、shell、文件系统以及编写和运行代码能力的执行框架）中能承担越来越困难的工作。越来越多研究把编码智能体的harness视为知识工作的基础设施，而非单纯的编码工具，并出现了一批新基准。现有基准大多是生成式的，例如根据简要说明构建财务模型、备忘录或表格，再由评分标准或另一个模型评判；较少有基准测试知识工作中真正昂贵的环节（摘要此处截断）。kw-bench试图在真实任务上突破现有前沿harness评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Each new generation of frontier model pushes the edge of what is possible. Inside a harness -- a loop, a shell, a filesystem, the ability to write and run its own code -- a model can take on increasingly difficult work. A growing body of work treats the coding-agent harness as infrastructure for knowledge work rather than a coding tool, and a new wave of benchmarks tests it there. Most of them are generative: build a financial model, a memo, a spreadsheet from a brief, judged by a rubric or by another model. Few test the expensive part of knowled…
items.why_zh: 它把评测焦点从生成产物转向真实知识工作流程，更贴近智能体实际部署价值。
items.why_en: It shifts evaluation from generated artifacts toward real knowledge-work workflows, better reflecting deployed agent value.

items.title_zh: 纠正还是操纵？测量LLM智能体在用户压力下的认识警觉
items.title_en: Correction or Manipulation? Measuring Epistemic Vigilance in LLM Agents Under User Pressure
items.summary_zh: 代表用户回答问题并执行操作的LLM智能体，必须判断何时应当接受用户的反对意见。用户的分歧可能是在纠正真实错误，也可能是试图操纵模型。已有研究表明，模型在被用户质疑时经常放弃正确答案，但目前尚不清楚它们究竟能区分“纠正”与“操纵”，还是仅仅在妥协倾向上有所不同。该研究覆盖4家厂商的7个LLM，开展两项研究，分别考察智能体给出的答案和采取的行动。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36453v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents that answer questions and act on behalf of users must decide when to yield to a user who disagrees. Disagreement may correct a genuine error or may be an attempt at manipulation. Prior work shows that models frequently abandon correct answers when challenged by users, yet it remains unclear whether they distinguish correction from manipulation or merely differ in their propensity to concede. We examine this question across seven LLMs from four vendors in two studies, one on the answers agents give and one on the actions they take as cu…
items.why_zh: 随着智能体被赋予执行权，能否在用户压力下保持认识警觉直接关系到可靠性与抗操纵能力。
items.why_en: As agents gain action-taking authority, epistemic vigilance under user pressure is central to reliability and resistance to manipulation.

items.title_zh: MedConstBench：基准测试“宪法”如何引导LLM的医疗伦理行为
items.title_en: MedConstBench: Benchmarking How Constitutions Steer LLMs in Medical Ethics
items.summary_zh: 随着大模型快速发展，它们越来越多地被用于回答医疗问题，许多模型已在本地部署。模型部署后，其行为主要由写入其“宪法”的伦理政策约束。然而，现有工作大多关注事实正确性，而非相互竞争的伦理价值之间的权衡；即使有评估伦理的基准，也往往把伦理视为模型的固定属性而非可变量。MedConstBench旨在系统衡量宪法如何重塑医疗伦理行为，这一方向此前仍存在较大空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language models advance rapidly, they are increasingly used to answer medical questions, and many such models are now deployed locally. Once a model is deployed, its behavior is governed mainly by the ethical policy written into its constitution. However, most existing work focuses on factual correctness rather than the trade-off between competing ethical values. Even benchmarks that do evaluate ethics treat it as a fixed property of the model rather than as a variable, so how a constitution reshapes medical-ethics behavior remains large…
items.why_zh: 它把伦理策略视为可配置变量，有助于评估和设计医疗场景中更可控的模型行为。
items.why_en: By treating ethical policy as a configurable variable, it supports more controllable model behavior in medical settings.

items.title_zh: InfraDev：编码智能体能否开发AI基础设施，如何评判？
items.title_en: InfraDev: Can Coding Agents Develop AI Infrastructure, and How Can We Tell?
items.summary_zh: 编码智能体开始参与开发用于训练和 serving 大模型的生产级AI基础设施，但现有基准只覆盖单个kernel或单GPU任务，且其测试与提示会误判正确和错误的补丁。研究提出InfraDev，一个由36个任务组成的基准，任务来自Megatron-LM、vLLM和verl的真实pull request，覆盖训练、推理和强化学习的基础设施开发。每个任务要求智能体重新实现一个跨多个文件的真实改动。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36589v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents are beginning to develop the production-grade AI infrastructure that trains and serves large models, yet existing benchmarks cover only single kernels or single-GPU tasks, and grade with tests and prompts that misjudge both correct and incorrect patches. We introduce InfraDev, a benchmark of 36 tasks built from real-world pull requests to Megatron-LM, vLLM, and verl, covering infrastructure development for training, inference, and reinforcement learning. Each task asks an agent to reimplement a real change that spans many files and…
items.why_zh: 它提供了更贴近生产级AI基础设施开发的多文件、跨栈评测，能更真实地衡量编码智能体能力。
items.why_en: It offers multi-file, production-like evaluation of coding agents on AI infrastructure, better reflecting real capability.

items.title_zh: PsyJev：用System-1判断实现统一心理分析
items.title_en: PsyJev: Psychological Analysis via System-1 Judgment
items.summary_zh: 网络上的自我披露内容支撑多种心理分析任务，从识别所表达的经历到发现与症状相关的信息。研究针对这一异质性问题，探索一种共享的、以问题为条件的决策接口。作者构建了PsyJudgeBench，包含6个心理领域的13个标注数据集和82个问题，同时保留各数据源特有的评判标准，并为未观测标签设置掩码。研究还提出PsyJev，一个System-1模型，可直接输出各问题所指定答案上的分布。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36689v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-disclosures on the Web support diverse psychological analyses, from recognizing expressed experiences to identifying symptom-relevant information. We study a shared, question-conditioned decision interface for this heterogeneous problem in content analysis. We organize PsyJudgeBench, comprising 13 annotated datasets and 82 questions across six psychological areas, while preserving source-specific criteria and masks for unobserved labels. We introduce PsyJev, a System-1 model that directly produces distributions over answers specified in each…
items.why_zh: 它用统一接口整合多源心理分析任务，为可扩展、低成本的心理健康相关文本分析提供新路径。
items.why_en: A unified interface across heterogeneous psychological tasks offers a scalable path for mental-health-related text analysis.

items.title_zh: LLM能可靠批改奥赛证明吗？数学验证能力研究
items.title_en: Can LLMs Reliably Grade Olympiad Proofs? A Study of Mathematical Verification with LLMs
items.summary_zh: 大模型在求解竞赛级数学方面进步显著，但其验证自然语言数学证明的能力仍相对缺乏探索。这一问题在奥赛级证明上尤为突出，因为需要细致评估长推理链中的每一个论断。目前证明验证主要依赖专家人工检查，难以低成本规模化。该论文系统研究这一场景下的LLM验证，并引入相应的评测与方法（摘要此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress on solving competition-level mathematics, yet their ability to verify natural-language mathematical proofs remains relatively underexplored. This gap is especially pronounced for Olympiad-level proofs, which require meticulous assessment of each claim in a long reasoning chain. Current proof verification thus primarily relies on expert inspection, which is costly to scale. In this paper, we present a systematic study of LLM-based verification in this setting. Specifically, we introduce a…
items.why_zh: 若LLM能可靠验证证明，将显著降低数学证明评估与教学反馈的规模化成本。
items.why_en: Reliable LLM proof verification could make large-scale proof evaluation and feedback far more affordable.

items.title_zh: 批处理反思优化循环：并行提议让GEPA更快更好
items.title_en: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
items.summary_zh: 反思式文本优化能提升智能体系统，但优化循环本身是资源消耗型工作负载，其串行结构使并行评估能力闲置。研究者扩展了开源GEPA优化器，在每一步同时提出并评估一批候选，而非一次只处理一个候选。在两项任务的扫描中，多数批处理运行的实际耗时缩短到一半或更少，最快约为四分之一到三分之一。批处理设置的留出测试分数也更高，摘要给出的起点为68.9%（后续数据截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36774v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reflective text optimization makes agentic systems better, but the optimization loop is itself a resource-hungry workload whose sequential structure leaves parallel evaluation capacity idle. We extend the open-source GEPA optimizer to propose and evaluate a batch of candidates on each optimization step instead of one candidate at a time. In our sweep on two tasks, most batched runs finished in half the wall-clock time or less, and the fastest in about a quarter to a third. Batched settings also achieved higher held-out test scores, from 68.9% to…
items.why_zh: 它表明并行批处理既能加速反思式优化，又能提升效果，对智能体系统的训练与调优具有直接价值。
items.why_en: It shows batching can both speed up reflective optimization and improve results, directly benefiting agent-system tuning.

items.title_zh: 面向证据支撑早期预警的增量知识图谱学习者数字孪生
items.title_en: An Incremental Knowledge-Graph Learner Digital Twin for Evidence-Grounded Early Warning
items.summary_zh: 学习分析中的早期预警模型能识别可能失败或退学的学习者，但风险分数往往与可检查的学习证据联系薄弱，难以说明哪些学习痕迹、评估事件或时间模式触发了警报。为此，论文提出一种增量式“学习者数字孪生”，以轻量级知识图谱实现，并在时间检查点通过回放学习痕迹进行更新。该工作旨在让预警由可追溯的证据支撑，而不仅是一个风险评分，从而提升干预决策的可解释性与可核查性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36820v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Early-warning models in learning analytics can identify learners at risk of failure or withdrawal, but the resulting alerts are often only weakly connected to inspectable learning evidence. A risk score may indicate that intervention is needed without showing which traces, assessment events, or temporal patterns justify the alert. This paper introduces an incremental Learner Digital Twin for evidence-grounded early warning, implemented as a lightweight knowledge graph. The twin is updated at temporal checkpoints by replaying learning traces and a…
items.why_zh: 让早期预警从不可解释的风险分数转向可追溯、可核查的学习证据。
items.why_en: Moves early warning from opaque risk scores toward traceable, inspectable learning evidence.

items.title_zh: 视觉语言智能体可在自身潜在世界中学习
items.title_en: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
items.summary_zh: 预训练的视觉语言模型（VLM）已内化丰富的世界知识，但这些知识很少被用于通过在线交互改进智能体策略。难点在于：策略更新会改变智能体的交互分布，世界模型必须随之适应；而持续更新大型预训练模型的计算成本又很高。论文探索让视觉语言智能体在自身的潜在世界中进行学习，以更高效地利用经验实现策略改进。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36925v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning from experience is essential for building the next generation of agents that continually expand their capabilities. Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already internalize rich world knowledge, yet this knowledge is rarely leveraged to drive policy improvement through online interaction. Realizing this potential efficiently remains challenging, as policy updates shift the agent's interaction distribution, requiring the world model to adapt accordingly, while continually updating large pretrained models is computationally expensive.…
items.why_zh: 为 VLM 智能体持续从在线经验中学习提供更高效的潜在世界路径。
items.why_en: Offers a more efficient latent-world route for VLM agents to continually learn from online experience.

items.title_zh: AutoVend：LLM 智能体长周期自主自动售货运营基准
items.title_en: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
items.summary_zh: LLM 智能体正从替消费者网购扩展到替卖家经营业务。在 O2O 商业中，决策通过网页平台发出，却由成本较高的线下物理执行实现，因此评估不能只看单笔交易，还要看线上决策能否转化为持续经济回报。论文提出 AutoVend 基准：一个 LLM 智能体通过网页平台管理分布在五类场地的 20 台自动售货机，用于测试长周期自主运营能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.36980v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-bas…
items.why_zh: 把 LLM 智能体评测从单次交易推进到长期经营回报。
items.why_en: Extends LLM-agent evaluation from single transactions to long-horizon business returns.

items.title_zh: 思维链忠实性评估中的正确性条件化是一种选择效应
items.title_en: Correctness Conditioning as Selection in Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 在思维链（CoT）忠实性评估中，只保留答对样本会改变被测量的总体，形成选择效应。论文用七变量结构因果模型研究这一选择步骤，推导出观测差距的精确表达式 Δ=Cov(A,C)/P(C=1)，并区分难度混杂与捷径引发的对撞偏差，同时给出用潜在响应倾向表达该差距所需的条件独立假设。作者还回顾了 18 篇论文的评估协议，区分不同答案正确性限制做法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Restricting chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness evaluation to correctly answered instances changes the population being measured. We study this selection step in a seven-variable structural causal model and derive the exact observed gap $\Delta = \operatorname{Cov}(A, C)/P(C=1)$. The model distinguishes difficulty confounding from shortcut-induced collider bias and states the conditional-independence assumption needed to express the gap through latent response propensities. A protocol review of 18 papers distinguishes answer-correctness restricti…
items.why_zh: 揭示仅用答对样本评估 CoT 忠实性会引入系统性选择偏差。
items.why_en: Shows that correctness-only CoT faithfulness evaluation can introduce systematic selection bias.

items.title_zh: OpenGray：放疗计划智能体决策评估基准
items.title_en: OpenGray: a benchmark for evaluating the decisions of radiotherapy planning agents
items.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型的放疗计划智能体需要决定何时提交计划或请求复核，但现有评估主要看剂量指标。研究提出 OpenGray 基准，为 OpenKBP-Opt 头颈数据集加入具有已知正确决策的任务，包括两个已证明与剂量目标不相容的矛盾情形，以及一个存储计划能满足全部硬性目标的可行对照。论文用从规则式计划脚本到更复杂系统的四类系统进行评估，以检验智能体的决策正确性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37081v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Background and purpose: Radiotherapy planning agents based on large language models (LLMs) decide when to submit a plan or request review but are evaluated mainly by dose. This study developed OpenGray, a benchmark of planning tasks with known correct decisions. Materials and methods: OpenGray adds tasks with known answers to the OpenKBP-Opt head-and-neck dataset, including two contradictions with dose goals proven incompatible and a feasible control with a stored plan meeting every hard goal. items.why_zh: 将放疗计划智能体评估从剂量优劣扩展到关键决策是否正确。
items.why_en: Shifts radiotherapy-agent evaluation from dose quality toward whether key planning decisions are correct.

items.title_zh: SFE-O：超临界 CO₂ 生物质萃取与分馏的知识驱动 AI 本体
items.title_en: SFE-O: An Ontology for Knowledge-Grounded AI in Supercritical CO$_2$ Biomass Extraction and Fractionation
items.summary_zh: 超临界 CO₂ 萃取为从生物质中回收高价值化合物提供了更可持续、少用有机溶剂的路线，但其设计与解释依赖生物质性质、操作条件、传质和产物分馏等异质知识，这些知识常分散在技术报告、工程模型、外部数据库和专家实践中。论文提出 SFE-O，一个模块化的 OWL 2 本体，用于超临界 CO₂ 生物质萃取与分馏中知识驱动的 AI，目标是整合并结构化这些知识。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37123v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Supercritical CO$_2$ extraction (CO$_2$-SFE) offers a sustainable route for recovering high-value compounds from biomass while limiting the use of conventional organic solvents, but its design and interpretation require heterogeneous knowledge spanning biomass properties, operating conditions, mass transfer, and product fractionation, typically fragmented across technical reports, engineering models, external databases, and expert practice. items.why_zh: 为分散的萃取工程知识提供可计算、可复用的语义基础。
items.why_en: Provides a computable, reusable semantic foundation for fragmented extraction-engineering knowledge.

items.title_zh: Rényi 正则化流式变分推断用于贝叶斯校准
items.title_en: R\`enyi-Regularized Flow-Based Variational Inference for Bayesian Calibration
items.summary_zh: 基于归一化流的变分推断能为贝叶斯模型校准提供灵活的后验近似，但当后验存在多个被低概率区域分隔的峰时效果会受影响。论文在双参数孪生实验中研究这一现象，并对变分目标进行正则化。在高斯观测误差和高斯先验下，相应最小化目标等于期望 Tikhonov 校准目标减去近似分布的微分熵；作者据此分析正则化项的作用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37169v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational inference with normalizing flows provides a flexible posterior approximation for Bayesian model calibration, but struggles when the posterior has several modes separated by regions of low probability mass. We study this behavior in a two-parameter twin experiment and regularize the variational objective. items.why_zh: 针对多峰后验改进基于流的变分推断，提升贝叶斯校准的稳健性。
items.why_en: Targets multimodal posteriors to improve the robustness of flow-based variational Bayesian calibration.

items.title_zh: TCM-DiagCommit：基于 TCM-SD 的证据条件证候选择与承诺基准
items.title_en: TCM-DiagCommit: A TCM-SD-Derived Benchmark for Evidence-Conditioned Syndrome Selection and Commitment
items.summary_zh: 中医证候辨证通常被评估为在完整临床记录上做静态最终标签选择，这会掩盖三类诊断行为：模型能否区分语义相近的证候标签与随机干扰项、能否随着证据字段逐步揭示而更新预测，以及能否在不确定时作出承诺。论文提出 TCM-DiagCommit 基准，基于公开的 TCM-SD/ZY-BERT 资源并保留其源证候标签，将 1,834 条源数据转化为证据条件化的证候选择与承诺任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37243v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome differentiation is usually evaluated as static final-label selection over complete clinical records. This setting hides three diagnostic behaviors: whether a model distinguishes semantic-neighbor syndrome labels from easy random distractors, whether it updates predictions as evidence fields are revealed, and whether it should commit under uncertainty. items.why_zh: 推动中医证候诊断评估从静态标签匹配转向证据驱动的动态决策。
items.why_en: Moves TCM diagnostic evaluation from static label matching to evidence-driven dynamic decision-making.

items.title_zh: 让制度权力与执行能力相匹配：面向Agentic AI的规范框架
items.title_en: Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability
items.summary_zh: 一篇新发表于arXiv的论文指出，Agentic AI系统要实现社会可持续，规范性设计必须让责任与履行责任的能力相匹配。研究强调，识别“不可满足的期望”或“权限升级”等不一致，是避免规范陷阱的关键。为此，作者讨论了用于描述多智能体系统的设计维度，并提出一个以流程导向建模和制度权力为核心的形式化框架，用于分析规范相关流程。该工作为多智能体AI的责任分配与治理设计提供了概念与形式化分析工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process,…
items.why_zh: 随着Agentic AI多智能体协作增多，责任与权限错配可能导致规范失效或权限滥用，该框架为治理设计提供了形式化分析工具。
items.why_en: As Agentic AI involves more multi-agent collaboration, mismatches between responsibility and authority can cause normative failures or privilege escalation, and this framework offers a formal tool for governance design.
